**Observation Log:**

[FACT] User is planning a fishing trip to Lake Tahoe next month.  
[EVENT] User is wondering about the best spots to fish for trout and bass at Lake Tahoe.  
[FACT] User tried fly fishing for the first time on their last trip but didn't catch anything.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Lake Tahoe is a fantastic destination for fishing and provided a list of trout fishing spots:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. South Shore: Baldwin Beach, Timber Cove, Zephyr Cove.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. North Shore: Kings Beach, Sand Harbor, Carnelian Bay.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided a list of bass fishing spots:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. South Shore: Emerald Bay, Rubicon Point.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. North Shore: Kings Beach, Crystal Bay.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided fly fishing tips:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Choose the right flies: dry flies like Elk Hair Caddis, nymphs like Hare's Ear, streamers like Woolly Bugger.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Pay attention to water conditions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Vary your presentation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Practice your casting.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Consider hiring a guide.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips included checking fishing regulations, being mindful of water levels, and respecting the environment.  
[USER] User is curious about fishing gear recommendations for spinning rods and lures for trout and bass at Lake Tahoe.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended spinning rods:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Trout Rods: Length 5-6 feet, Medium-light to medium power, Fast to extra-fast action.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Bass Rods: Length 6-7 feet, Medium-heavy to heavy power, Fast to extra-fast action.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended lures for trout:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Spinners: Mepps Aglia, Blue Fox Vibrax.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Jigs: 1/16 to 1/8 oz. marabou jigs, 1/8 to 1/4 oz. curly tail jigs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Soft Plastics: Small curly tail grubs, small plastic worms.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Spoons: Small spoons (1/16 to 1/8 oz
